gbm_population_evidence.quote: Glioblastoma; IDH Wild-type and STAT3-positive Glioblastoma
New histologically confirmed diagnosis of glioblastoma (WHO 2021)

candidate_evidence.quote: Each 3.7 g sachet of Sillbrain contains 500 mg silibinin. Every patient will assume 2 sachets/day for a total of 1 g/day of silibinin.

Evaluation of Progression Free Survival (PFS) in patients with newly diagnosed IDH wild-type and STAT3-positive glioblastoma using silibinin 2 sachets per day (1g/day), during chemoradiotherapy and maintenance treatment with temozolomide, compared with placebo.

candidate_flag.reason: Silibinin is registered as a Dietary Supplement (Sillbrain granulate); candidate only if silibinin counts as a licensed medicine rather than an unlicensed nutraceutical (manual 1.2).

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Silibinin in Association With Concomitant Chemoradiotherapy and Maintenance Temozolomide in STAT3 Positive IDH Wild-type, Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma Patients

role_evidence.quote: Concomitant radiotherapy (60 gy in 30 fractions) + temozolomide 75mg/mq + silibinin 2 sachets/day dissolved in water throughout concomitant treatment
Sillbrain will be available as granulate in sachets of 3.7g and it will be administered twice a day during chemo-radiotherapy and day 1-28 in maintenance phase every cycle.

agents.drug_class_hint: milk thistle flavonolignan (hepatoprotective; IV form used for Amanita poisoning); here oral nutraceutical granulate Sillbrain

flag.reason: Registered as Dietary Supplement; candidate status depends on whether silibinin is treated as a licensed medicine (manual 1.2, ascorbic-acid precedent).

role_evidence.quote: Experimental/Control arm: Concomitant radiotherapy (60 gy in 30 fractions) + temozolomide 75mg/mq + silibinin/placebo 2 sachets/day dissolved in water throughout concomitant treatment followed by temozolomide cp, 150 mg/m2-200mg/m2, g1-5 q28d

source_quote.quote: Immunohistochemical positivity of activated STAT3 (pSTAT3) expression on the tumor tissue sample.

flag.reason: Match to silibinin (registered as STAT3 inhibitor) is clear, but counts only if silibinin is accepted as a candidate.

coder_notes: Phase registered as NA (likely excluded at S3 regardless). Silibinin registered as 'Dietary Supplement' (Sillbrain granulate); coded as candidate under the licensed-moiety rule but flagged for adjudication; alternative coding is excluded_intervention_type with S6 exclusion. Placebo not listed as an agent. IDH-wildtype is a diagnostic requirement (WHO 2021) only. MGMT status availability is required for entry but the value is a stratification factor only. formulation_flag new_formulation because of the oral granulate nutraceutical product; adjudicator may prefer none.
